title: Native capture fixes that actually stick
changes: Prevented older Clips executables from overwriting the shared HDR and microphone engine after losing the single-instance lock.
Update restarts now shut down the capture engine before replacing native components, with retries for briefly locked files.
Added explicit diagnostics confirming whether NVIDIA microphone noise removal is attached and enabled.

title: Privacy-first About page
changes: Redesigned About settings to put privacy and data controls first, with a clear statement that recordings remain on your computer.
Reorganized app details, updates, diagnostics, and release history into clearer sections.

title: Adaptive HDR tone mapping
changes: HDR-to-SDR recordings now use the active display's Windows-reported SDR-white and peak-brightness levels instead of fixed values that could severely blow out highlights.
Capture logs now report the selected display and tone-mapping reference level for easier HDR troubleshooting.

title: Reliable update restarts
changes: Clips now opens its main window after a user-triggered update restart, even when it originally launched in the background.
Added an export-quality dropdown directly to the Trim editor and kept it synchronized with Editor settings.

title: Focused editor settings
changes: Removed the unfinished custom CDN upload integration and its credential settings.
Renamed Integrations settings to Editor so the remaining trim-quality option is easier to find.

title: Complete desktop recordings
changes: Manual desktop recordings now include all system playback audio, so browsers and other non-allow-listed apps can be heard.
The embedded player now keeps a consistent height when switching into the editor.

title: Persistent window controls
changes: The recording controls and Windows title-bar buttons now remain in a reserved top row across the library, Settings, and clip player.
The clip player stays below the title bar at compact window sizes instead of covering content behind the native window buttons.

title: Reliable overlay and commit nightlies
changes: Improved overlay topmost behavior and automatic recovery after renderer or loading failures.
Made game-window detection resilient to windows disappearing during a process scan.
Added overlay diagnostics for readiness, monitor placement, bounds, and topmost state.
Nightly builds now carry the short commit hash that identifies their source snapshot.

title: Live audio mixing
changes: Simplified the recording player to a single Edit action with the close button kept at the top right.
Audio source sliders and mute controls now update playback immediately without modifying the clip until Save is pressed.

title: Dedicated clip editor
changes: Replaced the player Edit menu with direct Trim and Audio actions.
Added a dedicated editor workspace with a large video preview and persistent Mix and Trim sidebar tabs.

title: Editing inside the player
changes: Moved Trim and Volume mix out of clip-card menus and into the recording player.
Playback now stays visible while adjusting individual audio source tracks.

title: True multi-track audio
changes: New recordings and replays now keep application and microphone audio on named, independently editable tracks.
Volume mixing rebuilds the default playback mix while preserving the source tracks and original video quality.

title: Clip volume mixer
changes: Added per-track volume and mute controls with options to update a clip or save a new mixed copy.
Moved clip editing actions into a compact three-dot menu.

title: Stable update checks
changes: Manual update checks are now available on both stable and nightly channels.

title: Startup reliability and changelog
changes: Stopped transient process-list output from surfacing as a startup error.
Added this scrolling release history to the About page.
Consolidated updates and telemetry behind clips.jss.fi.

title: First stable release
changes: Introduced separate stable and nightly update channels.
Raw recording thumbnails now skip the black frames before game capture appears.
Added optional anonymous version or diagnostic telemetry.
Bundled complete third-party licensing notices and source information.

title: Development releases
changes: Built the native libobs recording and replay-buffer engine.
Added per-application audio, MPV playback, trimming, storage cleanup, and restart-only updates.
Redesigned the recording library, settings, tray controls, and in-game notifications.
